title: ID0410469-DC/Si-D/EE-[hKzfTF] DC2 CableTempSensor error 51 times last 4 week (C1)
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Last 4 weeks there has been 164 charging session on DC2 cable and 51 times CableTempSensor failures and 31 times where the difference has been > 15 degree celsius.
Root cause:
Bad or damaged CCS2 cable. NOTE: CMS is in use.
Solution:
Open Ticket: No
Warranty Status: Active
Please DO NOT ADD MAIN ASSET BEFORE FINAL JUDGEMENT

additional_info.subject: Charger is reported CableTempSensor error 51 times in last 4 weeks
Note to ES Team
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause:
It seems the PT1000 temperature sensor is faulty because the temperature difference appears to be more than 15°C.
Problem Description:
RC raised the case stating that the “CableTempSensor” error was reported 51 times in the last 4 weeks & the temperature difference appears to be more than 15°C.
Action Performed (L2):
I verified this error in AWS and also noticed that it is interrupting the charging session (refer to the timestamp: 2025-02-09T09:59). The charger is running FW v3.2.8, and I requested an update to the latest version, but they are not ready to update this unit because of
There is a reason for that why some chargers are running with old FW because known FW bug in AC charging.
Charger SW Version:
v3.2.8
Reason for Handover (L3):
Further investigation as per Field issue excel sheet.
Log analysis with timestamp:
2025-02-09T09:59. I checked one session for this time when the session was interrupted due to the cable temperature sensor error.
Action Required
by HQ:
Further investigation.
Attachment
: Refer to the attached AWS logs screenshot below.

additional_info.subject: Additional Comment
additional_info.body: The main asset is not added in the note due to the RC's request. If we add the main asset, the end customer will see the case description, and they may ask what this case is about it to RC. (It seems this issue is not known to the end customer, and the RC doesn't want them to know about it just yet.)
